title: What Aerial Sky Cities Is
definition: Aerial Sky Cities: districts suspended on cables and towers above the ground.
description:
Aerial Sky Cities — Signature Edition: districts suspended on cables and towers above the ground. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature sky hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: suspension frames rethought, aerial transit rebuilt, wind engineering reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the cloud districts ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: The Signature Vision: Aerial Sky Cities
title: The Signature Vision: Aerial Sky Cities
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Aerial Sky Cities.
description:
The Signature vision of Aerial Sky Cities does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature sky hulls program, charter one: master suspension frames at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale aerial transit manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate wind engineering systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Aerial Sky Cities becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: The sky hulls Grid
definition: The sky hulls Grid: a load-bearing component of Aerial Sky Cities.
description:

In the Aerial Sky Cities architecture, the sky hulls grid is load-bearing: without it the sky hulls fails outright — Aerial Sky Cities stops being Aerial Sky Cities at all. Builders sequence this piece early because every other component assumes it works. In the Signature architecture this piece is designed first-class, not bolted on.

t: 2030 — The first sky hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first sky hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Aerial Sky Cities roadmap.
description:
The first sky hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its suspension frames grid and aerial transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the suspension frames results have to replicate outside the lab, aerial transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and wind engineering operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed suspension frames demonstrations, aerial transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting wind engineering uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Aerial Sky Cities
definition: Estimates Aerial Sky Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Aerial Sky Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a sky hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Aerial Sky Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Aerial Sky Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Aerial Sky Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 15635 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where suspension frames monitoring, aerial transit redundancy, or wind engineering maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Aerial Sky Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Aerial Sky Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Aerial Sky Cities — districts suspended on cables and towers above the ground.

Phase 1 — Prove (suspension frames): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (aerial transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (wind engineering): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cloud districts): sky hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and urban airspace-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
